description: Requires a WPF-to-WinUI port and a quality check of the resulting WinUI implementation.
prompt: Port Kestrel Index's WPF search panel into our existing WinUI 3 app, keeping QueryService. Then review the port for binding, async lifetime, and keyboard issues before we merge it.

paraphrases.novice: Can you move Kestrel Index's old WPF search screen into the WinUI 3 application we already have? Keep the search service, and check the result for problems with updating text, closing the screen, or using the keyboard.
paraphrases.terse: Kestrel: port WPF search pane to WinUI, then review the port. Reuse QueryService.
